verdict.rationale: Gitleaks runs fully offline as a local CLI/binary with no account or server dependency, and outputs findings in an open JSON format (`--report-format json`), so users are never locked into a proprietary store and can always take their scan data with them. This is a lighter-weight version of 'export and leave' than a SaaS with user accounts, but the openness and lack of lock-in are well documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exporting configuration/baseline data or any other stored state beyond scan reports, and independent corroboration beyond the vendor repo/probe.
